ops.action_failed: The action could not be completed.
ops.active_desc: Switch it off to stop alerting without losing the rule.
ops.alert_who: Who is alerted, and how often
ops.alerts_hint: E-mail the members of chosen roles when a measure reaches its threshold, at most once per quiet period.
ops.cooldown_hint: After an alert, the same rule waits this long before alerting again.
ops.edited_note: The values were corrected; the next retry uses them. The original submission is kept.
ops.emails_hint: Every e-mail the system sends, with its state and the exact reason when it failed. Choose one to read it as sent and resend it, to the same people or others.
ops.jobs_hint: Failures of background work from the last 30 days. Dismissing one keeps it on record with your reason.
ops.no_alerts_text: Add an alert to hear about failures before people report them.
ops.no_emails_text: E-mails appear here when notification rules, actions, automations and alerts send them.
ops.no_jobs_text: When an import, export, download, action run, automation, scheduled task or webhook call fails, it is listed here to retry or dismiss.
ops.no_submissions_text.discarded: Submissions an administrator discarded, with the reason given.
ops.no_submissions_text.failed: A save the system could not complete waits here, with what was entered, to be retried or discarded.
ops.no_submissions_text.rejected: Saves refused for a reason the person was shown, such as a validation message, are listed here for reference.
ops.not_retryable.extension: Fix the extension or roll it back, then repeat what failed.
ops.not_retryable.other: This failure cannot be retried from here.
ops.not_retryable.webhook: A webhook call is retried by retrying the action or automation run it belongs to.
ops.not_retryable.webhook_delivery: An incoming call is repeated by the system that sent it. Open the endpoint's call log to see what it sent.
ops.overview_hint: What needs attention now, and the health of the services the system depends on. Choose a count to see the items behind it.
ops.payload_hint: Values of sensitive fields are hidden and stay as submitted.
ops.payload_invalid: Enter the values as a JSON object.
ops.retry_confirm: Retry {n} submissions as the people who made them?
ops.submission_hint.discarded: Failed submissions an operator discarded, with the reason.
ops.submission_hint.failed: Saves the system could not complete. Retrying runs them again as the person who submitted them; a record is never created twice.
ops.submission_hint.rejected: Saves refused for a reason the person was shown, such as a missing value. They are listed for reference.
ops.subtitle: Failures and recovery: what is stuck or failed, and the health of the services the system depends on.
